Enabled.Name: Show dice trails
Enabled.Hint: Draw a particle trail on 3D dice: the damage type's trail on damage and healing dice, the roller's own trail on other rolls.

Intensity.Name: Trail intensity
Intensity.Hint: How bright, long and busy the trails are: the streak's brightness and length, the glow around the die and the number of particles. Lower it if rolls stutter on this computer.

Size.Name: Trail width
Size.Hint: How wide the streaks, the glow around the die and the particles are. 1 is a narrow streak about as wide as the die.

Afterglow.Name: Keep glowing after landing
Afterglow.Hint: Dice keep a faint aura and a few particles while they lie on the table, as if still charged.

Sounds.Name: Trail sounds
Sounds.Hint: Every trail sounds like its element: a quiet crackle, hum or whoosh while the die flies, and a loud burst, crack or clang whenever it bounces or lands. Plays on the Interface audio channel.

SoundVolume.Name: Sound volume
SoundVolume.Hint: How loud the trail sounds are, on top of Foundry's Interface volume slider. 0 is silent.

Editor.Name: Trails for regular rolls
Editor.Label: Open the Dice trails window
Editor.Hint: Design trails for attack rolls, checks, saving throws, initiative and other rolls that are not damage, for yourself or for each of your characters and tokens. Everyone at the table sees them on those rolls.

ShowOthers.Name: Show other players' trails
ShowOthers.Hint: Show the custom trails the other players designed on their rolls. Off: only your own trails and the damage type trails are drawn on this computer.

Control.Title: Dice trails: for the selected token, or your own

KindHint.other: Every other roll that is not damage or healing: hit dice, plain /roll commands, tables, ...

App.Title: Dice trails
App.NoDiceSoNice: Dice So Nice is not active, there are no 3D dice to give trails to.
App.TestRollHint: Roll a d20 on the table with the trail in the editor
App.PreviewHint: The die flies, rests a moment and goes again. The trail follows your Trail intensity and Trail width settings.
App.NoPreview: The preview could not be started, see the console (F12).
App.OwnerYouHint: Your own trails, for every roll you make that the character rolling has no trail for.
App.OwnerCharacterHint: Rolls made as this character use its trails; a kind of roll it has no trail for uses its player's.
App.EditKind: Load this trail into the editor
App.NoKinds: Tick the kinds of roll that should get the trail.
App.ColorHint: Recolour the layer around one colour of your choice
App.ApplyHint: Give the ticked kinds of roll the trail in the editor
App.RemoveHint: The ticked kinds of roll get no trail
App.ResetHint: Reset this layer's fine-tuning and effects
App.AddLayerHint: Add another effect on top of this trail
App.SoundHint: what this layer sounds like while the die flies and when it bounces
App.ImagePath: Path or URL of an image (PNG with transparency works best)
App.NoUpload: You may not upload files in this world; ask the GM, or pick an image that is already there.
App.NotImage: That file is not an image.
App.UploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded, see the console (F12) for details.
App.NoImage: A layer uses your own image but no image is chosen yet.
App.SaveHint: Save all layers as one trail
App.SavedHint: Saved trails are yours: they follow your user to any computer.
App.DeleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Rolls that already use it keep their trail.

Sound.lightning: Lightning: static and a sharp strike
Sound.necrotic: Necrotic: a dark drone and moans
Sound.force: Force: an arcane hum and pulse
Sound.needle: Needle: a thin whistle and ting
Sound.healing: Healing: a holy choir and chimes
Sound.ward: Ward: a shield hum and ping
Sound.charm: Charm: a dreamy chord and heartbeat
Sound.song: Song: a tune and strummed chords

Transfer.ExportHint: Save the trail in the editor as one file, including your own images, to use in another world or Foundry
Transfer.ImportHint: Load a trail file exported from Dice trails; its images are added to this world and it is saved to your saved trails
Transfer.ExportText: The trail in the editor, with all its layers and your own images, is saved as one file.
Transfer.ExportFailed: The trail could not be exported, see the console (F12) for details.
Transfer.NotEmbedded: These images could not be put in the file, so the file only refers to where they are: {files}
Transfer.Imported: Imported "{name}" and added it to your saved trails ({n} image(s) added to this world).
Transfer.ImportFailed: The file could not be imported: {error}
Transfer.BadFile: this is not a Dice trails file.
Transfer.TooNew: the file was made by a newer version of Dice trails; update the module first.
Transfer.ImageFailed: These images from the file could not be added to this world: {files}
Transfer.NoUploadImport: You may not upload files in this world, so these images from the file were not added: {files}. Ask the GM to import the file.
